snapshot: Watchlist CivicState: paid civic-letter tool with code, no market proof, operator ruling needed.
thesis: CivicState may be a small paid constituent-communications utility if users pay for researched, routed, citation-backed letters, but it is not yet an investible business-of-scale.

authority.adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption — operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

sourcesAndMethods.method: Extracted product definition, pricing, validation gates, constraints, market verdict, and sensitivity notes.
Mapped launch requirements, completed/pending evidence, out-of-scope items, and compliance constraints.
Preserved original phased narrative while correcting completion interpretation.
Used zero-traffic and zero-revenue claims, planned scale table, and detected contradictions with current code.
Preserved historical product architecture, business model, and deferred feature choices.
Sampled API, worker, payment, frontend, and Prisma implementation to separate real code from aspiration.
Applied watchlist/personal-research constraint and operator-confirmation sensitivity.

honesty.externalMarketClaims: All external market claims are assumptions because network research was unavailable.
honesty.quantitativeClaims: BUSINESS.md tags quantitative claims with [evidence] or [assumption].

decision.recommendation: Keep on watchlist until paid conversion, deliverability, and official coverage clear validation gates.
decision.reason: Repo contains meaningful CivicState implementation evidence, but registry and repo-local evidence show no market proof.

holes.hole: No market proof: repo audit says $0 revenue and 0 traffic.
holes.mitigation: Run narrow beta and instrument preview-to-checkout conversion.
holes.residualRisk: Users may prefer free manual outreach.

holes.mitigation: Complete domain warming and seed-list inbox tests before real sends.
holes.residualRisk: Government spam filters can still suppress compliant mail.

holes.mitigation: Run Cicero/BallotReady or replacement provider spike.
holes.residualRisk: Coverage/cost may break the low-price model.

holes.mitigation: Keep legal filings, demand notices, and unsupported factual allegations out of scope.
holes.residualRisk: Users may submit risky claims that require human moderation.

surpriseSpikes: Dispatch says brooks-history; repo-local evidence says CivicState.
.planning/existing-state.md says zero app code, but apps/ and packages/ contain implementation.
.planning/ROADMAP.md marks all phases complete, while .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md still has pending requirements.
MASTER_PLAN.md discusses dynamic pricing, but current payment route uses hardcoded tiers.

marketSizing.method: bottom-up from repo capacity/pricing and explicit assumptions
marketSizing.baseCase: $69,600 annual gross revenue at 4,800 campaigns/year and $14.50 AOV
marketSizing.capacityCase: $870,000 annual gross revenue at 5,000 submissions/month and $14.50 AOV

roadmapShape.traceability: Roadmap checkbox labels overlap BUSINESS.md headings.

operatorAsk: Confirm whether this repo should pitch CivicState as a business or remain a personal/research asset.
